snippet.title: RealToughCandy
snippet.description:
Do you want to learn about practical software & web development ? Or maybe you're ready to level up from hobbyist to de facto junior developer in the software industry? You've come to the right spot! 

With an emphasis on newbie developer topics (but plenty of fun for mid-level & senior devs) , RealToughCandy is your home for REAL-WORLD development. 

RTC features JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Vue, Angular & Svelte, career advice, freelance web development, and a TON more. 

Be sure to subscribe to keep updated with regular uploads, Premieres & more! 

👉👉👉Want a Job in Web Development? Check out my top-rated course with a special price for YouTubers: https://www.udemy.com/how-to-get-a-job-in-web-development/?couponCode=YOUTUBER

👉👉👉Invest in my book How to Get a Job in Web Development  https://amzn.to/2NAp2Ux

👉👉👉Website on fleek  www.realtoughcandy.com

👉👉👉 Udemy course reviews: www.udemyreview.com

👉👉👉Join the RTC Discord https://discord.gg/68yMWzV
